meta.title: Battle Royale design research — Fortnite / Final Drop / PUBG / Apex Legends
meta.purpose: Implementable spec for Last Circle (games/last-circle) — 50-player Three.js BR with building
sources: training-data: PUBG ballistics/loot, Apex Legends movement/shields/hit-feedback

what_we_took_from_each.fortnite: Building system (10 mats/piece, wall/floor/ramp/stair, free edits, material HP tiers), storm phase escalation, rarity tiers, harvest-from-world, boxed-up fighting, supply drops
what_we_took_from_each.final_drop_crazygames: Proof of the in-browser formula: vibrant low-poly island + loot + build walls/floors/ramps mid-combat + big lobby. Confirms art direction (bright, saturated, low-poly) and that browser BR needs instant no-install rounds and bot backfill
what_we_took_from_each.pubg: Bullet travel time + damage falloff by class, POI risk/reward loot density, positional audio as core information (gunshot direction, footsteps), circle pressure forcing rotations
what_we_took_from_each.apex_legends: Separate shield bar with consumable tiers, damage numbers + shield-crack hit feedback, fluid movement (sprint/slide momentum, no hard stops), death box loot piles, kill feed + placement screen

anti_goals_from_fortnite_bots.why: Epic's bots are the known failure mode: rarely build (single wall/ramp at most), no edits, no rotation strategy, laser detection but terrible aim, search chests then don't take ammo. Players clock them instantly.
anti_goals_from_fortnite_bots.our_bar: NPCs must loot coherently (weapon>ammo>shield priority), farm mats, rotate EARLY on storm ticks, use cover, box up when shot, ramp-push when advantaged, edit-through their own walls, disengage to heal, and vary by personality+skill tier so no two feel identical

standard.drop: glider spawn line across map edge, player picks drop point on map, NPCs spread weighted to POIs
standard.notes: ~8.5 min of storm + ~1 min drop/loot grace = typical 10-13 min match; center drifts randomly up to 25% of prior radius per phase

quick.spawn: already-landed hot start, mats head-start 100 wood

features: shooting range with distance-marked target dummies + moving targets
free-build zone, 9999 mats, all pieces unlocked
optional bot fights: spawn 1-10 bots at chosen skill tier

weapons.grid_note: damage = body hit; head_mult applies; rarity tiers common/uncommon/rare/epic/legendary give +8% dmg per tier and -10% spread/recoil per tier

table.notes: also harvest tool: 8 mats/hit, 12 on weak-point crit circle
first-shot accuracy when standing still + ADS
pellet spread cone 4deg; the boxfight weapon
scope ADS, glint visible to targets
destroys any structure in splash instantly

weapons.recoil: per-class vertical+random-horizontal pattern, recovers over 300ms; ADS halves spread, crouch -25%, moving +40%, jumping +100%
weapons.hit_feedback: damage numbers float off target (white=body, gold=head, blue=shield), hitmarker cross on crosshair, shield-crack sound at shield break (Apex), kill confirm banner + feed entry

building.placement: ghost preview snapped to grid facing camera; hotkeys Z/X/C/V (wall/floor/ramp/stair) + Q toggles last, mouse wheel or F edits; instant place, HP ramps up
edit_patterns: wall: door(bottom-mid out), window(mid), half-wall(top row out), diagonal
building.support_rule: piece needs terrain contact or connected chain to terrain; break support = cascade destroy (with debris particles)
building.turbo_build: hold to place repeatedly at 150ms interval

loot.chest: golden glow + ambient shimmer audio within 12m, 3-item burst: weapon + ammo + (consumable|mats)
loot.floor_spawn: weapon OR ammo box OR consumable at ~55% of designated spawn points
loot.supply_drop: 1 per mid-game phase, balloon crate drifting down at visible map point, legendary weapon + big shield + 100 mats
loot.death_drop: everything the player/NPC carried spills as a loot pile
loot.poi_density: named POIs 2.0x spawn density (high risk high reward, PUBG model); roadside/wilderness 0.4x
loot.inventory: 5 weapon/consumable slots + reserve ammo per type + 3 material counts; auto-pickup ammo/mats, E to pick items

movement.feel: Apex-style: momentum-preserving acceleration (t_accel ~0.18s), no hard stop on direction change, slight camera lag on sprint start, FOV +6 while sprinting
movement.third_person: camera 4.2m back, 1.6m up, shoulder offset 0.7m; ADS zooms to 2.2m + tighter shoulder; sniper ADS = scope overlay

list.name: Isla Viva (Vibrant Tropical Island)
list.theme: final-drop-style saturated tropics: white beaches, turquoise shallows, palm clusters, volcano center, beach shacks, jungle village, shipwreck cove, cliff temples
list.verticality: volcano + cliff temples = high ground; beaches low
list.water: ocean ring + lagoons (slow wade, no build on deep water)

list.name: Ashgrid (Urban City Ruins)
list.theme: collapsed downtown: cracked towers (enterable, stair-cored), rubble streets, overpass segments, metro entrances, plaza, crane high-point

list.name: Deepwood (Dense Forest Wilderness)
list.theme: tall conifer + birch forest, ranger towers, logging camp, lake cabin hamlet, hunting blinds, river cut, rock outcrops

list.name: Proving Grounds
list.theme: flat range + build lot + parkour course, used by Practice mode only

maps.per_map: 8-10 named POIs, each with loot table multiplier, chest count, structure set; heightmap = seeded simplex octaves + POI flattening; NPC drop weights per POI

ai_npcs.priority: HIGHEST — must feel like real players
ai_npcs.architecture: utility-scored state machine over a blackboard (per-bot memory of last-seen enemies, heard shots, known loot), ticked staggered (each bot decides every 150-400ms, near-player bots more often); movement/aim run every frame for bots in player bubble, simplified integrator beyond

personalities.traits: pushes on any shot heard <120m, loots fast+sloppy, prefers shotgun/smg
farms mats to 300+ early, fights vertical, boxes on damage
edge-of-zone rotations, bushes/buildings, snipes, avoids pushes unless target weak
max loot route, avoids fights until forced, opens every chest
moves on phase-start immediately, center-zone control, third-parties fights it hears
high-ground hold, relocates after 2 shots, keeps 150m+ engagement range

behaviors_required: drop: pick POI by personality (rusher=hot, goblin=edge), glide there, loot nearest weapon FIRST
loot: prioritize weapon > shield > ammo > mats > upgrade rarity; take from own kills' death piles
farm: harvest trees/rocks/cars between fights to personality-target mats
rotate: on phase start, path toward next circle biased through cover; sprint if storm closing on them; NEVER die dumb in storm (unless tier 1, rarely)
engage: LOS + range gate by weapon; strafe-fire; crouch at range; lead moving targets with travel-time weapons
take_cover: on taking damage, move to nearest cover OR place wall (tier 2+) within reaction time
box_up: tier 3+ at <40 HP builds 1x1 + heals inside; tier 4+ edits window to peek
ramp_push: tier 3+ with HP+mats advantage ramps toward enemy, wall-behind (tier 4+)
disengage: low HP + no mats/heals = smoke-break LOS and run; heal when safe
third_party: hearing a fight within 150m -> rotator/rusher move to it, arrive late, hit weakened winners
endgame: <10 alive = mats matter most; tier 4-5 build to high ground, tier 1-2 hide in storm edge; final 1v1 aggression ramps
humanizers: overshoot flick then correct, miss more while both moving, occasional reload at bad time (tier<=2), look-around idle head turns, varied name pool + kill-feed presence all match
ai_npcs.perception: vision cone 110deg to 200m (fog/foliage cuts it), hearing: gunshot 250m w/ direction, footsteps 18m; memory decays 8s after LOS lost -> searches last-known-pos
ai_npcs.fairness: bots obey identical rules: same weapons, ammo, mats, build costs, storm damage; no wallhacks — target selection only from perception

multiplayer.transport: Supabase Realtime Broadcast+Presence (existing ffg_netplay.js), room code lobby + quick match
multiplayer.authority: lowest-peer-id = host: runs storm, loot seed, NPC sim; broadcasts snapshots 10Hz, clients interpolate 100ms behind; client sends own input/state 15Hz
multiplayer.join_replace: joiner takes over the highest-skill living NPC slot (or reserves a slot in lobby); NPC brain detaches, human input attaches; on disconnect the brain reattaches seamlessly
multiplayer.scale_note: 50 real players via broadcast relay is out of scope; design = 1-8 humans + NPC fill, which matches the goal (friends join, NPCs fill)

screens: main menu (logo, PLAY, mode+map select cards, settings, practice)
lobby (50 slots filling with names, map vote shown, countdown)
HUD (hp/shield bars bottom-left, weapon slots bottom-right, mats+build piece top-right, minimap top-left w/ storm ring + player dot + pings, storm timer + alive count top-center, kill feed right)
settings (master/music/sfx volume, graphics low-med-high, mouse sensitivity, ADS sensitivity, keybind remap)
post-match stats (placement, kills, damage dealt, accuracy, mats farmed, time survived)
ui.style: clean slightly-rounded panels, saturated accent per map theme, big readable numbers; Final Drop/Fortnite bright not mil-sim gray

audio.sources: pipeline/assets impact-sounds/interface-sounds/rpg-audio (~350 stock), positional via Web Audio PannerNode
audio.music: menu theme + match ambient beds per map + endgame intensity layer; from F:\Music catalog (no duplicate across games rule) or procedural fallback

techniques: one skinned character model shared, NPCs>60m switch to no-anim capsule-billboard LOD
AI decision stagger (49 bots / 8 per frame max)
spatial hash grid 16m cells for perception/bullet queries
no per-frame allocations in hot loops
shadow map 1024, only sun light + hemisphere, strip GLB lights on load
far-sim: bots outside 250m of any human simulate at 2Hz waypoint level (fights between far bots resolved statistically but fed to kill feed — keeps world alive at low cost)
